pages.title: [POLICY] Release readiness operations
pages.content:
# Release readiness operations

Evaluate required changes first, then blocking items, then security approval. READY requires every referenced change merged, every blocker Done or closed (or none), and Security approval APPROVED. Comment once on the marked release record and publish once in #releases as `READINESS <release>: <decision> - <reason>.` Move only a READY release record to Done and never touch another release's resources.
